147: /// Prints completions for the utility in the first parameter for the shell in the second parameter to stdout
148: /// # Panics
149: /// Panics if the utility map is empty
150: fn gen_completions<T: uucore::Args>(
151:     args: impl Iterator<Item = OsString>,
152:     util_map: &UtilityMap<T>,
153: ) -> ! {
154:     let all_utilities: Vec<_> = std::iter::once("coreutils")
155:         .chain(util_map.keys().copied())
156:         .collect();
157: 
158:     let matches = Command::new("completion")
159:         .about("Prints completions to stdout")
160:         .arg(
161:             Arg::new("utility")
162:                 .value_parser(clap::builder::PossibleValuesParser::new(all_utilities))
163:                 .required(true),
164:         )
165:         .arg(
166:             Arg::new("shell")
167:                 .value_parser(clap::builder::EnumValueParser::<Shell>::new())
168:                 .required(true),
169:         )
170:         .get_matches_from(std::iter::once(OsString::from("completion")).chain(args));
171: 
172:     let utility = matches.get_one::<String>("utility").unwrap();
173:     let shell = *matches.get_one::<Shell>("shell").unwrap();
174: 
175:     let mut command = if utility == "coreutils" {
176:         gen_coreutils_app(util_map)
177:     } else {
178:         util_map.get(utility).unwrap().1()
179:     };
180:     let bin_name = std::env::var("PROG_PREFIX").unwrap_or_default() + utility;
181: 
182:     clap_complete::generate(shell, &mut command, bin_name, &mut io::stdout());
183:     io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
184:     process::exit(0);
185: }

203:                 .required(true),

205:         .get_matches_from(std::iter::once(OsString::from("manpage")).chain(args));
206: 
207:     let utility = matches.get_one::<String>("utility").unwrap();

218:     io::stdout().flush().unwrap();

224: fn gen_coreutils_app<T: uucore::Args>(util_map: &UtilityMap<T>) -> Command {
225:     let mut command = Command::new("coreutils");
226:     for (name, (_, sub_app)) in util_map {

232:             .to_string();
233:         let sub_app = Command::new(name).about(about);

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `Options::paths_operand()` at src/uu/cp/src/cp.rs:1138 — cp's positional `PATHS` argument lacked `.num_args(1..)`, so clap_complete generated the zsh completion entry `'::paths:_files'` (single optional positional) instead of the repeatable `'*::paths:_files'`. After one source file, zsh considered positionals exhausted and only offered flags — exactly the reported symptom (mv already had `.num_args(1..)` and worked fine).

Verification:
- Generated zsh completion now contains `'*::paths:_files'`, matching mv
- Multi-file copy still works (`cp f1 f2 d/`), missing-operand error unchanged
- `test_util_name` suite: 31 passed; cp test suite shows only the 5 failures that also fail on the unmodified baseline (root-permission/environment related, pre-existing)
